svg.title: Kite I
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-color-panels-for-a-large-wall-11-2018/lightbox/works/kite-i-1952-44834; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
